Use case: style-transfer.
Create a NEW PawTrail 2D dialogue portrait spritesheet for Amber from the supplied appearance reference, in the previously selected REFINED CEL pixel-art style.
IMAGE 1 is APPEARANCE ONLY: the brown-haired outrider with amber-orange eyes, a tall red rabbit-ear ribbon bow with cream/gold tips, bronze goggles resting on her forehead, long chestnut hair, scarlet cropped jacket/capelet with gold piping, white fitted bodice and burgundy accents. Preserve her recognizable face, warm fair skin and this outfit. No bow weapon or extra props. Hands out of the bust crop; goggles stay on the forehead, not over her eyes. Do not copy the reference background or hand pose.
IMAGE 2 is ART STYLE ONLY: reproduce its Refined cel portrait language, fuller hair shapes, expressive refined eyes, detailed yet controlled flat shaded face, rounded highlights, rich clean cel-shaded pixel clusters and illustrated upper torso. Do NOT copy the pink hair, shrine ornaments, clothing or identity of the style sample. Brown hair, red bow and forehead goggles must be obvious in every frame.
Output exactly 5 COLUMNS by 6 ROWS. Every cell contains a complete transparent head-and-upper-chest portrait at the SAME 96×120 native pixel density, centered with fixed eye line and bust baseline. Use clear transparent gutters of at least 4 native pixels. Entire bow, hair and shoulder silhouette must fit each cell. Keep identical anatomy, hair, goggles, ribbon and clothing in all cells. No text, labels, borders, background or interface.
ROWS: neutral/calm, gentle smile, happy, sad, angry/annoyed, surprised.
COLUMNS: resting expression; half blink with that row resting mouth; fully closed blink with that row resting mouth; small speaking mouth with resting eyes; wider speaking mouth with resting eyes.
Happy has BOTH eyes closed in smiling arcs throughout all five cells, joyful upturned speech. Sad keeps raised inner brows and downturned lips while talking. Angry keeps inward brow tension and angry teeth/shout shapes. Surprised keeps wide eyes, raised brows and startled lips. Smile speech keeps raised corners; neutral speech restrained. Blinks must keep each emotion's brow and mouth. No floating features, second mouths or wink substitutions.
Refined cel is STILL pixel art: crisp stepped edges, no blur, no gradients, no 3D rendering, no smooth high-resolution anime painting. Use a cohesive limited chestnut/scarlet/gold/ivory/skin/amber palette. Strict FRONT view in all 30 cells. Output only the complete spritesheet, true transparent alpha.
